items.title: Every point of H over an absolutely integrally closed algebra lifts to a point of G
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file etale-cohomology.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma states the surjectivity of G(R) -> H(R) for an absolutely integrally closed A-algebra (statement lines 14682-14686). The proof (proof lines 14688-14698) reads a point of H as a map on the t-chart, uses monicity of Phi to solve Phi(b) = a, and applies the monogenic lemma to build the compatible map on the s-chart. H2: one explicit lifting, written out.
